description: This Java class 'InteropDataValidator' provides validation and parsing methods for various interoperation-related data requests within the Fineract project. It handles validation and extraction of transfer requests, identifiers, transactions, and quotes from JSON commands, utilizing helper classes and data validation frameworks.

classes.name: InteropDataValidator
classes.description: A validator component for interoperation data requests within the system, responsible for validating and parsing JSON commands into specific data request objects.

methods.name: validateAndParseTransferRequest
methods.description: Validates and parses a transfer request from a JSON command, returning an InteropTransferRequestData object.

methods.name: validateAndParseCreateIdentifier
methods.description: Validates and parses the creation of an identifier with specified type and value from a JSON command.

methods.name: validateAndParseCreateRequest
methods.description: Validates and parses a generic interoperation transaction request from a JSON command.

methods.name: validateAndParseCreateQuote
methods.description: Validates and parses a quote creation request from a JSON command.

methods.name: validateAndParsePrepareTransfer
methods.description: Prepares and validates a transfer request, delegating to validateAndParseCreateTransfer.

methods.name: validateAndParseCreateTransfer
methods.description: Validates and parses a transfer request from a JSON command, similar to validateAndParseTransferRequest.
